sections.title: Identification and form
sections.text: This entry represents Malva sylvestris, common mallow, an upright perennial reaching about 1 m. Native to Europe and western Asia, it is naturalised widely and occurs on waste ground and roadsides.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The leaves are about 5–10 cm long. The magenta-pink flowers, veined with dark purple, are about 2.5–5 cm across.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: Young leaves and flowers are eaten in some food traditions. Herbal references describe traditional infusion use, which is not evidence of a medical treatment.
